scripts.text: Jingle Bells! Jingle Bells! Jingle all the way!
scripts.translation: 叮叮当！叮叮当！铃儿响叮当！

scripts.text: O' what fun it is to ride in a one-horse open sleeeigh, Hey!
scripts.translation: 坐着单马拉的敞篷雪橇，真是快乐呀——嘿！

scripts.text: Hey! You! What comes to mind when you think about Christmas?
scripts.translation: 嘿！你！一想到圣诞节，你会想到什么？

scripts.text: Jingle Bells! Jingle Bells! Jingle all the way!
scripts.translation: 叮叮当！叮叮当！铃儿响叮当！

scripts.text: O' what fun it is to ride in a one-horse open sleigh!
scripts.translation: 坐着单马拉的敞篷雪橇，真是快乐呀！

Hey, girl! What comes to mind when
There's a rumor that Santa Claus lives in a certain village all throughout the year.
scripts.translation: 有传言说，圣诞老人一年到头都住在某个村庄里。

scripts.text: You guys can meet Santa on either of the five possible villages throughout Rune-Midgerts!
scripts.translation: 你们可以在卢恩-米德加兹的五个村庄之一见到圣诞老人！

scripts.text: If you win over Santa, you can get a gift. Would you go for it?
scripts.translation: 只要战胜圣诞老人，就能得到礼物。要试试看吗？

scripts.text: Isn't it thrilling to open gifts over your head!!
scripts.translation: 举过头顶打开礼物，多让人兴奋啊！！

scripts.text: Some villain, a fake Santa robbed some gifts from the good Santa!
scripts.translation: 有个假圣诞老人抢走了真正的圣诞老人准备的礼物！

scripts.text: Furthermore, he has put bad magic on the gifts so that they become monsters!
scripts.translation: 而且，他在礼物上施了邪恶的魔法，让它们变成了魔物！

scripts.text: Ah, a music box is useful.
Though we can't all play it around the village as we planned, it's cool that you carry it.
scripts.translation: 虽然不能按原计划在村里到处播放，但能随身带着音乐盒，也挺不错的。

scripts.text: We want to enjoy carols all together... I hope to get Crystal Pieces!
scripts.translation: 我们想和大家一起欣赏颂歌...真希望能找到水晶碎片！

scripts.text: If you can get ^0000FFSinging Crystal Pieces^000000, give them to me please?
scripts.translation: 找到^0000FF歌唱水晶碎片^000000的话，能把它们给我吗？

scripts.text: Why not? Sure, I can give you some.
If you can get ^0000FFSinging Crystal Pieces^000000, give them to me please?
scripts.translation: 找到^0000FF歌唱水晶碎片^000000的话，能把它们给我吗？

scripts.text: I can bake you a cake, and I can carve your name on the cake, if you want!
scripts.translation: 我可以给你烤个蛋糕，你愿意的话，还能在上面写上你的名字！

scripts.text: Many people live in the giant world!
scripts.translation: 世界这么大，住着那么多人！

scripts.text: So many people hope to hear Caroller, yet I always lack Crystal pieces.
scripts.translation: 许多人都想听我唱颂歌，可我总是缺少水晶碎片。

scripts.text: If you can get ^0000FFSinging Crystal Pieces^000000, give them to me please?
scripts.translation: 找到^0000FF歌唱水晶碎片^000000的话，能把它们给我吗？

scripts.text: Let's care about others around you on this Christmas season!
scripts.translation: 在这个圣诞季，让我们多关心身边的人吧！

scripts.text: Anyway, thanks a lot for your help.
scripts.translation: 总之，非常感谢你的帮助。

scripts.text: Many people live in the giant world!
scripts.translation: 世界这么大，住着那么多人！

scripts.text: So many people hope to hear Caroller, yet I always lack Crystal pieces.
scripts.translation: 许多人都想听我唱颂歌，可我总是缺少水晶碎片。

scripts.text: If you can get ^0000FFSinging Crystal Pieces^000000, give them to me please?
scripts.translation: 找到^0000FF歌唱水晶碎片^000000的话，能把它们给我吗？

scripts.text: Let's care about others around you on this Christmas season!
scripts.translation: 在这个圣诞季，让我们多关心身边的人吧！

scripts.text: I've been waiting for this for when
But there's been no caroling here and there like before, so we can't feel the Christmas spirit.
scripts.translation: 可现在不像以前，到处都能听到颂歌了，连圣诞气氛都淡了。

scripts.text: So, I installed a Singing Crystal in Prontera...
scripts.translation: 所以，我在普隆德拉安装了一个歌唱水晶...

scripts.text: but that jerk Antonio broke the crystal!
scripts.translation: 但那个混蛋安东尼奥把水晶弄坏了！

scripts.text: The gift boxes have been changing into monsters since Antonio placed some magic on them, so the monsters ate up the crystal fragments!
scripts.translation: 安东尼奥给礼物盒施了魔法，把它们变成魔物，那些魔物又把水晶碎片吃掉了！

scripts.text: I am so devastated, since the Singing Crystal has been the hope of many children around the villages.
scripts.translation: 周围村庄的许多孩子都盼着听歌唱水晶呢，这让我难过极了。

scripts.text: There's no other way to carol?
scripts.translation: 没有其他办法唱颂歌了吗？

scripts.text: You can hear carols in Lutie.
And just stay there, every Christmas, for your whole life?
scripts.translation: 那就每年圣诞节都待在那里，一辈子都这样吗？

scripts.text: Maybe, it's quite hard to make a jukebox for the villages, but a music box might be possible.
scripts.translation: 给村庄做点唱机也许不容易，不过音乐盒应该能做出来。

scripts.text: We need the ^0000FFSinging Crystal Pieces^000000 that the monsters ate up.
scripts.translation: 我们需要魔物吃掉的^0000FF歌唱水晶碎片^000000。

scripts.text: Please bring me ^0000FF6 Singing Crystal Pieces^000000, and you will be rewarded with presents!
scripts.translation: 带来^0000FF6个歌唱水晶碎片^000000，我就送你礼物！

scripts.text: ...Why are you staring at me like that?
You're thinking that we are always getting our plans spoiled, aren't you?
scripts.translation: 你是不是在想，我们的计划怎么总被人搞砸？

scripts.text: I know that we are not good at controlling stuff, but our rewards are good, right?
scripts.translation: 我知道我们不太会处理这些事，不过给的奖励还不错，对吧？

scripts.text: You are so cruel to me!

scripts.translation: 拜托了，为了孩子们的希望！！！

scripts.text: Please bring me 6 Singing Crystal Pieces from ^0000FFViolent Gift Boxes^000000!
scripts.translation: 请从^0000FF暴力礼物盒^000000身上收集6个歌唱水晶碎片带来！

scripts.text: They're definitely as harsh as their name.
scripts.translation: 它们还真是名副其实的凶暴。

scripts.text: You know, the santa costumes that the monsters are wearing now aren't genuine!
scripts.translation: 你知道吗，魔物现在穿的圣诞老人服装不是正品！

scripts.text: The rumor 'round here is, Lutie's designer made these costumes.
scripts.translation: 听说这些服装是姜饼城的设计师做的。

scripts.text: Every year, adventurers challenge to attack Antonio the fake Santa, but there's no way to catch up to him due to his hat and costume!
scripts.translation: 每年都有冒险者挑战假圣诞老人安东尼奥，可他有那顶帽子和那身衣服，谁也追不上！

scripts.text: Are there some special abilities within them?
scripts.translation: 难道帽子和衣服有什么特殊能力？

scripts.text: There's still the designer in the Christmas village... How about asking her to make that costume?
scripts.translation: 那位设计师还在圣诞村呢...不如请她也做一套？

scripts.text: As I heard, this Antonio is quite different from before.
scripts.translation: 我听说，这个安东尼奥和以前很不一样了。

scripts.text: He seems to be quite resolved with himself since he ran away from people before.
scripts.translation: 以前他总是逃跑，现在似乎下了决心，不再像以前那样了。

scripts.text: And he isn't alone anymore... is what I heard...
scripts.translation: 而且，他现在不是独自行动了...听说是这样...

scripts.text: Maybe, it's quite hard to make a jukebox for the villages, but a music box might be possible.
scripts.translation: 给村庄做点唱机也许不容易，不过音乐盒应该能做出来。

scripts.text: We need the ^0000FFSinging Crystal Pieces^000000 that the monsters ate up.
scripts.translation: 我们需要魔物吃掉的^0000FF歌唱水晶碎片^000000。

scripts.text: Please bring me ^0000FF6 Singing Crystal Pieces^000000, and you will be rewarded with presents!
scripts.translation: 带来^0000FF6个歌唱水晶碎片^000000，我就送你礼物！

scripts.text: For all of the children of this world!!!
scripts.translation: 为了这世上所有的孩子！！！

scripts.text: Please bring me ^0000FFSinging Crystal Pieces^000000 from ^0000FFViolent Gift Boxes^000000!
scripts.translation: 请帮我收集^0000FF歌唱水晶碎片^000000，去找那些^0000FF暴力礼物盒^000000吧！

scripts.text: They're definitely as harsh as their name.
scripts.translation: 它们果然和名字一样凶猛。

scripts.text: Santa won't give you a gift if you're crying.
scripts.translation: 如果你哭了，圣诞老人就不会给你礼物了。

scripts.text: They are so cruel, aren't they?
I'm happy to see you again.
All right! We can start to make our music box with crystal fragments.
scripts.translation: 好！这下能用水晶碎片做音乐盒了。

scripts.text: We would amplify the sounds of the crystal fragments to sound through the music box.
scripts.translation: 把水晶碎片的声音放大，再通过音乐盒播放出来。

scripts.text: You know, a music box that sounds like a jukebox!
scripts.translation: 也就是说，做个能像点唱机一样播放音乐的音乐盒！

scripts.text: It's handy. You can carry it, as well as listen to sweet carols anywhere.
scripts.translation: 它很方便。你可以随身携带，随时随地聆听甜美的颂歌。

scripts.text: So, we need more of some materials.
^0000FF10 Trunk, 1 Hammer Of Blacksmith, 1 Jubilee, 10 Sticky Mucus, 3carat Diamond^000000!
scripts.translation: ^0000FF10个树干、1个高级铁砧、1个朱毕雷、10个粘稠液体和3克拉钻石^000000！

scripts.text: We can make a music box with Singing Crystal Pieces.
scripts.translation: 用歌唱水晶碎片就能做音乐盒。

scripts.text: It's handy, you can hear carols anywhere. Sounds cool?
scripts.translation: 随身带着，走到哪里都能听颂歌，是不是很棒？

scripts.text: So, we need more of some materials.
^0000FF10 Trunk, 1 Hammer Of Blacksmith, 1 Jubilee, 10 Sticky Mucus, 3carat Diamond^000000!
scripts.translation: ^0000FF10个树干、1个高级铁砧、1个朱毕雷、10个粘稠液体和3克拉钻石^000000！
铃儿响叮当，铃儿响叮当，

Did you bring all the materials?
No need to hesitate! Let's get started to make our music box.
scripts.translation: 不用犹豫！我们开始制作音乐盒吧。

scripts.text: Blacksmith hammers on trunk... and we shape the frame.
scripts.translation: 用高级铁砧敲打树干...把框架做出来。

scripts.text: Please use the Singing Crystal Pieces for a column, the Diamond as a prop, and the Sticky Mucus as glue.
scripts.translation: 请使用歌唱水晶碎片作为支柱，钻石作为支撑，粘稠液体作为胶水。
我们用朱比利装饰一下...

scripts.text: It's so cool! Isn't it cute!!?!
You did as I requested, so I will give you gifts, as promised.
scripts.translation: 你帮我办好了这件事，接下来该兑现承诺，送你礼物了。
第一份礼物，就是这个音乐盒。

scripts.text: Please play this music box all over the villages!
scripts.translation: 带着它到各个村庄播放吧！

scripts.text: Another present is a Christmas cake especially shaped like your name!
scripts.translation: 另一份礼物，是特意做成你名字形状的圣诞蛋糕！

scripts.text: I made this cake shaped like your name!
scripts.translation: 你看，形状就是你的名字哦！

scripts.text: Wow! Were you naughty or nice this year?
scripts.translation: 哇！今年你是乖孩子，还是调皮的孩子呢？

scripts.text: All right, what comes to your mind when you think about Christmas?
scripts.translation: 说到圣诞节，你最先想到什么？

scripts.text: A sweet carol always makes Christmas more happy!!!
scripts.translation: 动听的颂歌总能让圣诞节更快乐！！！

scripts.text: Yes indeed Carolling spreads Joy throughout the world?
scripts.translation: 是啊，颂歌能把欢乐传遍世界，对不对？

scripts.text: Ho ho ho! What a good boy!
scripts.translation: Ho ho ho! 真是个乖男孩！

scripts.text: Ho ho ho! What a good girl!
But you should be wary of a fake Santa romaing around.
scripts.translation: 不过，要小心那个到处乱跑的假圣诞老人。

scripts.text: Have you heard of Antonio, who invades villages every Christmas?
scripts.translation: 听说过安东尼奥吗？他每年圣诞节都会闯进村庄捣乱。

scripts.text: He has stolen my gifts, as well as attacked adventurers around Toy and Lutie field.
scripts.translation: 他偷走了我的礼物，还袭击了玩具城和姜饼城野外附近的冒险者。

scripts.text: A bad Santa ruins us good Santa's reputations!
scripts.translation: 坏圣诞老人把我们这些好圣诞老人的名声都毁了！

scripts.text: The World Santa Organization is considering this a grave situation.
scripts.translation: 世界圣诞老人组织对这件事非常重视。

scripts.text: A gift box! That sounds good!
It's so exciting to open gift boxes when you wake up on Christmas morning!!!
scripts.translation: 圣诞节早晨一醒来就能打开礼物盒，多让人兴奋啊！！！

scripts.text: But we have very little gifts now, since Santa Antonio has stolen my gift bag.
scripts.translation: 可现在剩下的礼物不多了，安东尼奥偷走了我的礼物袋。

scripts.text: Many adventurers try to catch up to him, but he is not easy to catch.
scripts.translation: 许多冒险者试图追上他，但他并不容易抓住。

scripts.text: Anyway let those adventurers try to catch him, I have a small game for you.
scripts.translation: 总之就让那些冒险者去抓他吧，我有个小游戏要和你玩。

scripts.text: I will give you a small gift if you beat me!
scripts.translation: 如果你赢了我，我会给你一份小礼物！

scripts.text: Do you want to play a game with me?
scripts.translation: 你想和我玩个小游戏吗？

scripts.text: If you've been a little naughty this year I won't stuff your stockings with coal.
scripts.translation: 如果你今年有点淘气，我也不会往你的袜子里塞煤块。

scripts.text: I will stay here throughout the Christmas season, just visit me when you change your mind.
scripts.translation: 圣诞节期间我都会在这里，改变主意了就来找我吧。

scripts.text: Um... You've played the game recently haven't you?
scripts.translation: 嗯...你最近玩过这个游戏吧？

scripts.text: You can try the game once a hour.
Please visit me after the one hour has passed.
scripts.translation: 等满一小时再来找我吧。

scripts.text: Let me explain how to play this game.
I will pick one of three cards: Poring Card, Ghostring Card, and Angeling Card.
scripts.translation: 我会从三张卡片中选一张：波利卡片、幽灵波利卡片和天使波利卡片。

scripts.text: Guess which card I pick and you're a winner!
scripts.translation: 猜中我选的是哪张卡片，你就赢了！

scripts.text: If you guess right 3 times out of 5, I will give you a gift.
scripts.translation: 如果你能在5次中猜对3次，我就给你一份礼物。

scripts.text: First let me shuffle up these cards... Ok!!!
Can you guess the right card the next time around?
Now this gift is for you.
Put your hand into the bag and pick only one.
scripts.translation: 把手伸进袋子里，只拿一样。

scripts.text: Good job! Thanks for playing the card game with me!
scripts.translation: 做得好！谢谢你陪我玩纸牌游戏！

scripts.text: Do you mean that ever so fashionable costume for Santa's and youngsters!?!
scripts.translation: 你是说圣诞老人和年轻人都爱穿的时尚服装吗？！

scripts.text: Light-weight, fashionable, and keeps you warm!
There used to be designer who visited my house to make my Santa costumes.
scripts.translation: 以前有位设计师来我家，帮我做圣诞服装。

scripts.text: You should open your heart to the spirit of Christmas!
scripts.translation: 敞开心扉，感受圣诞节的精神吧！

scripts.text: Once you do, I know you'll be able to think of something.
scripts.translation: 只要这样，一定就能想到些什么。

scripts.text: I always thought about how boring Santa Claus is wearing a too boring costume.
scripts.translation: 我一直觉得，圣诞老人穿着那身毫无新意的衣服，实在太单调了。

scripts.text: I could make a glamorous style for him!
scripts.translation: 我能给他设计一个华丽的造型！

scripts.text: I once made a costume for the notorious figure Antonio!
scripts.translation: 我曾经为大名鼎鼎的安东尼奥制作过一套服装！

scripts.text: The reason catching up to him is so hard, is that his clothes have been given strong power!
scripts.translation: 很难追上他，是因为他的衣服被赋予了强大的力量！

scripts.text: I blessed them with good luck!
scripts.translation: 我为它们施加了幸运祝福！

scripts.text: Which is quite luxurious but sold at good price ~
You can share my sense of fashion and wear my look if you run a light mission for me.
scripts.translation: 帮我完成一个小任务，就能体验我的时尚品味，穿上我设计的服装。

scripts.text: You're silly! You lost your big chance!
scripts.translation: 真傻！你错过了大好机会！

scripts.text: Come to me later if you want to get the mission.
scripts.translation: 想接任务了就回来找我吧。

scripts.text: I, Louise Kim, am generous enough to accept you next time.
scripts.translation: 我路易丝·金这么大方，下次也会给你机会。

scripts.text: I'm only in need of some materials. Things that are beyond my ability...
scripts.translation: 我只是需要一些材料...有些东西超出了我的能力范围...

scripts.text: Anyway, can you bring me some stuff?
scripts.translation: 总之，你能帮我带点东西来吗？

scripts.text: Why not? What do you need?
You need to bring me: ^0000FFCotton Shirt, 3 Red Potion, Holy Water, 4 Wrapping Paper, Wrapping Lace^000000.
scripts.translation: 请带给我：^0000FF棉衬衫、3瓶红色药水、圣水、4张包装纸和包装用缎带^000000。

scripts.text: If you bring me all that stuff, I can make you a glamorous Santa costume.
scripts.translation: 如果你把这些东西都带给我，我就能为你做一套华丽的圣诞老人服装。

scripts.text: If you were to bring me all the stuff, I would make you a wonderful costume, for free...
scripts.translation: 如果你把这些东西都带给我，我会免费为你做一套很棒的服装...

scripts.text: Please see me again if you are interested.
scripts.translation: 如果你有兴趣，请再来找我。

scripts.text: I will show you my limitless ability.
scripts.translation: 我会让你见识我无穷的本领。

scripts.text: All over the world will be blessed tonight!
scripts.translation: 今晚全世界都将得到祝福！

scripts.text: All over the world will be blessed tonight!
scripts.translation: 今晚全世界都将得到祝福！

scripts.text: I am a genius of the world.
You can call it what you wish.
I ain't envious of Designer Pierre.
scripts.translation: 我才不羡慕设计师皮埃尔。

scripts.text: I am supposed to get paid well, however I will just let it be free, since this is Christmas!
scripts.translation: 我本来应该收很多钱的，但既然是圣诞节，我就免费给你吧！

scripts.text: Go brag about these wonderful clothes. There wouldn't be any without me, Louise Kim.
scripts.translation: 尽管去炫耀这些漂亮衣服吧。没有我路易丝·金，可就没有它们。
